tools.name: get_timeline_state
tools.description: Get the full timeline state including all tracks, clips, and composition settings.

tools.name: get_media_library
tools.description: Get all imported media files available for use on the timeline.

tools.name: get_clip_at_time
tools.description: Get the clip at a specific playhead time position.

time.description: Time position in seconds to query.

tools.name: get_selected_clip
tools.description: Get the currently selected/active clip and its properties.

tools.name: add_clip
tools.description: Add a media file to the timeline at a specific position.

media_file_id.description: ID of the media file from the library to add.

track_id.description: Target track ID. If omitted, adds to the first video track (V1).

timeline_start.description: Start time on the timeline in seconds. Defaults to 0.

tools.name: remove_clip
tools.description: Remove a clip from the timeline by its ID.

clip_id.description: ID of the clip to remove. If omitted, removes the currently selected clip.

tools.name: trim_clip
tools.description: Trim a clip's source start or end point. Adjusts which portion of the source media is shown.

clip_id.description: ID of the clip to trim. If omitted, uses the currently selected clip.

source_start.description: New source start time in seconds. Trims from the beginning.

source_end.description: New source end time in seconds. Trims from the end.

tools.name: move_clip
tools.description: Move a clip to a new position on the timeline, optionally to a different track.

clip_id.description: ID of the clip to move. If omitted, uses the currently selected clip.

timeline_start.description: New start time on the timeline in seconds.

track_id.description: Target track ID. If omitted, stays on the current track.

tools.name: apply_effect
tools.description: Apply a visual or audio effect to a clip.

clip_id.description: ID of the clip to apply the effect to. If omitted, uses the currently selected clip.

parameters.description: Effect-specific parameters as key-value pairs. Keys correspond to the effect's parameter IDs.

tools.name: update_effect_param
tools.description: Update a parameter on an already-applied effect.

clip_id.description: ID of the clip. If omitted, uses the currently selected clip.

applied_effect_id.description: ID of the applied effect instance on the clip.

parameters.description: Updated parameter values as key-value pairs.

tools.name: remove_effect
tools.description: Remove an applied effect from a clip. Use this to undo an apply_effect call — pass the applied_effect_id returned by apply_effect.

clip_id.description: ID of the clip the effect is on. If omitted, uses the currently selected clip.

applied_effect_id.description: ID of the applied effect instance on the clip (returned by apply_effect).

tools.name: toggle_effect
tools.description: Enable or disable an applied effect without removing it. Useful for previewing 'before/after' or temporarily suppressing an effect.

clip_id.description: ID of the clip the effect is on. If omitted, uses the currently selected clip.

applied_effect_id.description: ID of the applied effect instance on the clip.

enabled.description: True to enable the effect, false to disable it.

tools.name: list_filter_categories
tools.description: List all FFmpeg filter categories with their filter counts. Use this to discover what kinds of filters are available before browsing specific categories.

tools.name: list_filters
tools.description: List available FFmpeg filters, optionally filtered by category or keyword search. Returns filter names, types, and descriptions.

category.description: Category ID to filter by (e.g. 'color', 'blur', 'transform'). Get valid IDs from list_filter_categories.

query.description: Keyword to search filter names and descriptions.

tools.name: describe_filter
tools.description: Get detailed info about a specific FFmpeg filter including all its parameters, types, defaults, and value ranges.

filter_name.description: Name of the FFmpeg filter to describe (e.g. 'eq', 'hue', 'gblur').

tools.name: compose_recipe
tools.description: Compose an FFmpeg filter recipe and attach it to a clip. The recipe is a filter graph with nodes (filters + params) connected in sequence. Validates structure before attaching.

clip_id.description: ID of the clip to attach the recipe to. If omitted, uses the currently selected clip.

recipe.description: Recipe object with 'nodes' array (each node has 'id', 'filter', 'params' or 'raw') and 'connections' array (each has 'from' and 'to' node IDs, using 'input'/'output' for endpoints).

tools.name: validate_recipe
tools.description: Validate a recipe by compiling it to an FFmpeg filter string and running a dry-run. Returns the compiled filter string on success, or an error describing what's wrong.

recipe.description: Recipe object to validate (same format as compose_recipe).
